title: My camp slasher kill sequence got removed, so here's the family-friendly cut (and how it was made)
author: clockwork_blue

comments.author: clockwork_blue
comments.body: [Here's a brief artifact with the workflow](https://claude.ai/artifact/XyJCXsULf2qEJtEJHEp6Xx) (Yes it's all claude's writing, but I promise I also read it). I can help if some things aren't clear enough.

comments.author: KolobingaS
comments.body: You can animate by dragging IK bones right in game editior?

replies.author: clockwork_blue
replies.body: Sort of. It's not the game editor, it's a small browser tool I built just for fixing. The animation itself comes from a script (the drag-out) and a bought mocap pack (the kill). The tool loads those clips with both characters, and then yes: you grab a hand or foot and drag it, the arm or leg follows with two-bone IK, and that becomes a key on a timeline that blends in and out. You can also pin a hand to the other character so it stays on her (e.g. neck, shoulder) while they both move. When it looks right the keys get baked back into the clip the game plays.
